description.main: Untitled (Kiss) is Barbara Kruger's edition of Alvar Aalto's Stool 60, made by Artek with the Institute of Contemporary Arts, London, in an edition of 600.
description.extended:
Untitled (Kiss) is Barbara Kruger's edition of Alvar Aalto's Stool 60, made by Artek with the Institute of Contemporary Arts, London.

The stool has a round white laminate seat printed with the word KISS in tall black letters, set on three red-painted bent birch legs. It stands 44 cm high with a seat 38 cm across. The ICA dates the work to 2019 and issued it in an initial run of 300 followed by a further 300, for an edition of 600. Each stool is hand-numbered and carries the artist's stamp on the underside, beside Artek's label naming Aalto as designer.

Untitled (Kiss) was the first in a series of artists' versions of Stool 60 commissioned by the ICA and Artek, with a Fischli/Weiss stool announced as the next. Kruger made it in support of the ICA, the first institution to give her a one-person show, in 1983.
description.artist_bio: Barbara Kruger (b. 1945, Newark) is known for her pictures and words. Her photographic works, installations and multichannel videos engage issues of power, gender and identity. She received the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the 51st Venice Biennale in 2005 and the Kaiserring Goslar in 2019.

notes: One stool. Commissioned by the Institute of Contemporary Arts, London, and produced by Artek, Helsinki, on Alvar Aalto's Stool 60. The ICA dates the work 2019 and gives the edition as 600 (an initial multiple of 300 and a continuation of 300), each hand-numbered with the artist's stamp on the underside. Examples catalogued by Wright, Chicago, carry decal labels reading 'Artek Made in Finland 2020 / Barbara Kruger' and are dated 2020 there. Materials and dimensions (painted birch, laminate, 17 1/4 in high x 15 in diameter, 44 x 38 cm) follow the Wright catalogue. The number and label date of this example are not recorded here.
